name: Citizenship by Registration -- Marriage to a Citizen

qualifying_event.description: A person married to a Grenadian citizen may apply to the Minister for registration as a citizen, regardless of the applicant's own age or legal capacity.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate; spouse's proof of Grenadian citizenship.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires marriage to a Grenadian citizen. No residence-duration requirement is specified in the Act; applies equally regardless of the sex of the applicant or the citizen spouse.
If the applicant is a British protected person or an alien, they must take the oath of allegiance.

evidence_required.document: Second Schedule application form (marriage details, spouse's citizenship, marital status history)
Oath of allegiance (if alien or British protected person)

sources.title: Grenada Citizenship Act, 1976, Section 5(3) (primary legislation, official application form Schedule 2/Regulation 4): registration for persons married to a Grenadian citizen, no stated residence duration, oath of allegiance required only for aliens/British protected persons, gender-neutral as to applicant or citizen spouse

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Grenada's initial build. Like Saint Lucia (and unlike the Bahamas), this route is NOT restricted by the applicant's sex -- Section 5(3) applies 'whether or not that person is of full age and capacity' and makes no distinction based on which spouse holds citizenship. No residence-duration or minimum marriage-length requirement is stated in the Act itself -- this is a faster, more direct route than the family-based Permanent Residence marriage track sourced separately in gd_permanent_residence_family.json (which cites a 3-year marriage duration from a tier-3 source, likely describing a different, slower residence-first pathway rather than this direct citizenship-registration route).
